title:
Vacuum handling device having a suction nozzle
and gripper part contained within a single housing

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.quote: Preferably the housing unit 4 is designed in the form of a hollow body, which contains a cavity 5 which is preferably continuous in the longitudinal direction and in which the principal components of the device are accommodated.
features.note: The reference describes a housing unit as a hollow body containing a cavity for components, which can be gripped.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: The invention relates to a vacuum handling device comprising a vacuum source, which possesses a suction nozzle means adapted to operate on the ejector principle and furthermore a suction gripper which possesses a gripper part connected with the suction side
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum source operating on an ejector principle within the housing, but does not explicitly state it is electrically operated.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference describes exhaust air exiting the housing, but does not teach guiding it through a hollow grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device in the grip portion.

features.item: A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: The gripper part 26 has, at its free end axially opposite to the housing unit 4, a flexible suction cup 27 or an at least partially flexible suction plate, which is secured in a sealing manner to a plunger body
features.note: The reference describes a suction plate or suction cup secured in a sealing manner to a plunger body, which acts as a carrier.
features.refuted: The quote mentions a suction cup/plate but does not describe a carrier plate or a seal extending around it.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip

features.note: The reference describes a housing unit that combines a vacuum source and suction gripper, and is a hollow body, but does not specify an electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through the grip, or sound-damping in the grip.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.quote: The vacuum handling device 1 is composed of two principal parts, that is to say a first part in the form of a vacuum source 2 and a second part in the form of a suction gripper 3 . These
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum handling device combining a vacuum source (grip unit) and a suction gripper (with suction plate) into a single housing unit.
features.refuted: The quote describes vacuum source and suction gripper as separate parts, not their combination in a single apparatus.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping material lining the grip portion.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: The vacuum handling device 1 is composed of two principal parts, that is to say a first part in the form of a vacuum source 2 and a second part in the form of a suction gripper 3 .
features.note: The reference describes the vacuum source as a 'first part' of the device, implying it is a distinct portion of the housing.
features.refuted: The quote only identifies the vacuum source as a principal part, not its arrangement within a housing portion.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing device or material in the housing portions.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.quote: The housing unit 4 preferably possesses an elongated configuration and is preferably manufactured integrally.
features.note: The reference describes an elongated housing unit that combines the vacuum source and suction gripper, but does not explicitly define distinct 'first' and 'second' housing portions with an air outlet on the second portion, nor does it route exhaust through the grip.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not describe an air collection screw or any specific mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.quote: Following this the pressure medium is directed by a deflector wall 24 of the suction nozzle 7 to the laterally arranged outlet 17 .
features.note: The reference describes a deflector wall directing the pressure medium (exhaust) to a lateral outlet, which functions as a baffle.
features.refuted: The quote describes a deflector wall but does not specify it is bent/curved, downstream of grip portion, or relates to air baffles.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes the vacuum source and suction gripper as a rigid structural unit, not releasably connected.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: The gripper part 26 has an aspiration duct 42 extending axially through it. Such duct opens at one end into the active plenum 35 and at the other end into a suction space 43 delimited by the Suction cup 27
features.note: The reference describes an aspiration duct connecting the active plenum (connected to the suction nozzle) to the suction space delimited by the suction cup.

claims.quote: A vacuum handling device comprising a vacuum source, which possesses a suction nozzle means adapted to operate on the ejector principle and furthermore a suction gripper which possesses a gripper part connected with the suction side of the suction nozzle
claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum handling device with a vacuum source and suction gripper, but it does not specify that it is for a hand-operated laying device or for use with a suction plate.

claims.quote: The vacuum handling device 1 is composed of two principal parts, that is to say a first part in the form of a vacuum source 2 and a second part in the form of a suction gripper 3 .
claims.note: The reference describes a housing for a vacuum source and suction gripper, but it does not explicitly mention a 'grip portion for gripping the grip unit' or an 'electrically operated' vacuum generating device. The vacuum source operates on an ejector principle, which is typically pneumatic, not electric.

claims.quote: Preferably the housing unit 4 is designed in the form of a hollow body, which contains a cavity 5 which is preferably continuous in the longitudinal direction and in which the principal components of the device are accommodated.
claims.note: The reference states the housing unit is a hollow body, but it does not specifically state that the 'grip portion' (which is not explicitly mentioned) is designed as a hollow body.

claims.quote: Finally the suction nozzle 7 furthermore possesses an outlet opening 16 which is connected with an outlet 17 opening to the outer face of the housing unit 4 , and accordingly leading into the atmosphere, from the housing unit 4
claims.note: The reference describes an outlet for exhaust air from the vacuum generating device, but it does not state that this exhaust air is guided through a 'grip portion' (which is not explicitly mentioned) to an air outlet, nor does it mention a sound-damping device.
This reference does not disclose a sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion.
This reference does not disclose a grip portion at least partially lined with a sound-damping material.
This reference does not disclose a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion of the housing.
This reference does not disclose a sound-reducing device arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a housing unit with a vacuum source and a suction gripper, but does not describe a grip portion elongated between a first and second housing portion with an air outlet on the second housing portion.
The reference does not disclose an air collection device, such as an air collection screw, arranged upstream of a grip portion for collecting exhaust air.
The reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion to guide exhaust air to an air outlet.
The reference does not disclose a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing.
The reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.note: The reference describes a vacuum handling device.

claims.quote: The gripper part 26 has, at its free end axially opposite to the housing unit 4 , a flexible suction cup 27 or an at least partially flexible suction plate, which is secured in a sealing manner to a plunger
claims.note: The reference discloses a suction plate or suction cup secured in a sealing manner to a plunger body, which can be considered a carrier plate. However, it does not explicitly state that the seal extends around the carrier plate.
The reference does not include a 'grip unit according to claim 1' as claim 1 is not provided in the context of this reference.
The reference describes a gripper part with a suction cup, but does not mention a releasable connection between a grip unit and a suction plate via a coupling device.

claims.quote: The gripper part 26 has an aspiration duct 42 extending axially through it. Such duct opens at one end into the active plenum 35 and at the other end into a suction space 43 delimited by the Suction cup 27
claims.note: The quote describes an aspiration duct within the gripper part that connects to a suction space (suction chamber) delimited by a suction cup (suction plate) to generate a vacuum for holding an object.
claims.refuted: The assertion references claim 9 and specific elements (grip unit, suction plate) that are not present in the quote, which describes different components (gripper part, suction cup).
